description: What people said about the product: ratings, picked options and their own words, newest first, with who said it. Filter by feature (an id from list_features, or a feature key such as "search"), status or source. A new note can carry suggestion: the open request featury's model says it is most likely about (probability 0.8 or more); link_feedback adds it there. A note a visitor sent from a support card can carry summary: the assistant's short summary, which the visitor chose to send with their words. A card the visitor hasn't sent never shows. When private grouping is enabled, the first page also returns up to 20 similarGroups with note counts, distinct saved identities and unidentifiedNotes (never invented people). These groups only help browsing; pass similarGroup to inspect the notes. MANAGER+ required.

feature.description: A feature id from list_features, or a feature key such as "search"

similarGroup.description: A group id from similarGroups. Reads its notes; never links them

source.description: Only feedback that came this way: SERVER, HELP, IMPORT and so on

status.description: Only feedback in this status: NEW, LINKED (in a request) or DISMISSED. Without it, all three

name: list_feedback
title: List feedback
